scope: Complete HBQ enabled/feature helpers and CBE live configuration side-effect comparison
findings: HBQ enabled resolves vehicle Disable then vehicle Enable with global default, so a vehicle can run while the global default is off. Feature resolution layers vehicle variables over CBA defaults.

CBE CortexFeatureEnabled retains global disable authority and group disabled-feature filters. Do not add vehicle force-enable around stopped scheduling or competing controller ownership merely to copy precedence.

CBE does not currently provide equivalent per-vehicle per-driving-feature overrides. Existing external ownership markers are handover contracts, not substitutes for operator settings. This source intent remains incomplete.

Live configuration review found delayed counter-battery callbacks bound only to the master-stop generation. Off/on of the counter-battery feature could restore validity of a previously delayed emission response.
implementation: CBA counter-battery disable advances only the server delayed-response generation. Existing radar response and observer wake callbacks keep their original generation.

Pending per-side cooldown receipts now include generation/deadline, allowing fresh emissions after re-enable without inheriting a cancelled pending slot. Completed-fire and emission-rate cooldowns remain.

Updated CortexInit documentation: the artillery firing-evidence handler is shared and installed while tactics runs; counter-battery admission independently reads the live switch. No runtime handler was added or removed.
remaining: Already accepted server fire missions, owner RPCs in transit and delayed shoot-and-scoot need independent off/on generation analysis. This change does not claim to cancel those cases or in-flight projectiles.
Per-vehicle feature filtering, full-HBQ controller parity and physical live toggles remain incomplete.
